summary_1line: Agastya drinks the ocean so the gods can destroy the Kalakeya demons hiding within it; afterward he cannot restore the water.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Agastya stands at the roaring shore and drinks the entire ocean as gods, sages, and celestial beings watch in astonishment.
With the ocean bed exposed, the gods armed with celestial weapons descend upon the Kalakeya demons hiding in the depths.
The slain demons, adorned with golden ornaments, lie across the seabed like blossoming palasa trees after the divine battle.
